fullScope.whyUnqualified: No complete source-defined regional/sector row matrix, unique calendar dates, finite masses, true-zero/missing distinction or all-sector totals have been validated. Do not assume every region-sector Cartesian combination exists.

territorialAndBunkerCrosswalk.sourceFact: 2025 report page 7 places international bunkers in global total and ROW.
territorialAndBunkerCrosswalk.whyUnqualified: The original seven-account requirement keeps Rest of World and International transport distinct. A direct use of the reported ROW would overlap transport; subtracting guessed bunker shares or summing country totals would not qualify the original accounting boundary. Requires actual source-native bunker sector rows and verified non-overlap, not a headquarters or generic global proxy.

freshIndependentOutcomes.sourceFacts: 2025 report page 1 describes hourly/daily power generation, monthly industrial production/indices, daily city mobility, flight/monthly transport data and monthly building fuel corrected with daily temperature.
freshIndependentOutcomes.whyUnqualified: Daily emission labels are modeled estimates using heterogeneous activity frequencies, not automatically independently observed daily CO2. Need row/sector-specific upstream observation dates, disaggregation/extrapolation/revision flags and overlap with forecast inputs. Shared activity/factor inputs cannot be scored as independent target evidence merely because a different publisher supplies the emissions estimate. This does not declare all Carbon Monitor sectors stale or unusable.

projectionExclusion.sourceFact: The 2025 report explicitly projects October 1 through December 31 using data ending September 30.
projectionExclusion.requiredTreatment: Exclude those projected months from realized-outcome qualification; do not digitize/annualize chart lines or blend them into an observed full-year target.

originRule.why: Original file identities, dates and pre-origin availability not established. Retrieval timestamps/current hashes/publication dates of different objects cannot stand in for archived release bytes. Any future live download is revised history unless separate source evidence proves otherwise.

frozenEstimator.why: The retained EIA estimator is fixed to US electric-power CO2 and its exact original issue cells; it cannot be transplanted to Carbon Monitor global seven-sector data. The Carbon Monitor fallback expressly requires separately frozen source-specific boundaries and pre-outcome operational methods. No such complete admitted Carbon Monitor contract exists here.

Without that dependency, do not repeat the failed/catalogue/rights routes or download latest history merely to call it an original vintage.

Only if the full original contract and unchanged applicable frozen holdout are actually ready may execution proceed. If a new Carbon Monitor-specific estimator remains needed, freeze it before outcome inspection rather than retrofitting the EIA or annual-curated protocol.
